caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair shown in three-quarter view, angled slightly to the left. The chair has a light brown wooden frame with a slanted, rectangular backrest attached to two uprights, along with a horizontal support connecting the uprights beneath the backrest. The seat is made of woven material in a square shape, displaying a pattern with visible texture and subtle shades of gray, beige, and brown. The legs of the chair are turned, with the two front legs more ornately detailed than the simpler back legs, and all four legs are joined by horizontal and diagonal stretchers. The background of the drawing is plain, with a light cream or off-white color and no additional objects or detailing apart from the signature near the bottom right corner.
title: Chair (Samuel Chase)
